messages:
Nora Blake: Sapphire Therapeutics (renewal in 6w) requested a 75m onboarding bootcamp next week focused on alerting, model-pin strategies, and cost tuning. They asked for a hands-on lab + renewal pulse. Can we schedule something that covers EMEA late afternoon -> APAC morning overlap?
Adrian Cole: I can lead the alerting + dashboards section. Suggest slotting 15:00-16:15 UTC. That hits CET late afternoon and early APAC morning.
Jules Rivera: I can do model pinning and rollback drills. For the lab we'll need a sanitized config + a small test dataset. Recommend breakout rooms for the lab.
Kai Nakamura: For cost tuning I'll do a short quant & batching primer. Agenda idea: 10m intros, 20m alerts, 20m model-pin/rollback, 20m hands-on breakouts, 5m renewal pulse/feedback.
Nora Blake: Sounds good. Customer wants seats for 18 (mix of engs + infra + PM). Also asked for a short pre-survey to tailor breakouts.
Jules Rivera: Posting prework checklist: 1) attendee list by EOD Tue 2) sanitized config + read-only creds 3) pre-survey link 4) confirm breakout hosts (2).
Remi (calendar-bot): Provisional event created: Sapphire Bootcamp  provisional on CS calendar. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/sapphire-bootcamp. Poll posted: `poll: ["15:00-16:15 UTC","13:30-14:45 UTC"]` Closing in 4h.
Adrian Cole: I'm flexible but prefer 15:00 slot to avoid internal infra overlap. Jules + Kai can you host breakouts?
Jules Rivera: I can host breakout A. Kai can host B if that's OK. I'll prep the rollback runner script: `scripts/rollback-drill.sh` and a pared-down runbook.
Kai Nakamura: OK to host breakout B. I'll prepare cost-tuning labs and a troubleshooting checklist.
FormsBot: Created feedback form: https://forms.gle/redwood-sapphire-feedback. Questions include "confidence after bootcamp (1-5)", "top remaining blocker", "interest in follow-up workshop (yes/no)". Responses tagged for renewal follow-up.
Nora Blake: For renewal signal capture please mark any "top remaining blocker" flagged as high risk in the renewal doc. We'll escalate to AMs if needed.
Remi (calendar-bot): Poll closed  majority selected `15:00-16:15 UTC`. Event confirmed and invites sent to listed attendees. Recording enabled; breakout channels pre-created: #sapphire-bootcamp-breakout-a, #sapphire-bootcamp-breakout-b.
Adrian Cole: I'll upload the dashboard walkthrough and slides by Mon COB. Jules will post the rollback script and runner notes.
Jules Rivera: Shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/sapphire-bootcamp (agenda, runbook, prework). I'll add lab instructions and host notes.
Nora Blake: Great work team. Moving execution into #sapphire-bootcamp and closing this scheduling thread. Follow-ups in the new channel. :party_parrot:
